entries.106752cd6d6bc2f7: This division develops, produces and sells excavating machinery such as hydraulic excavators and mini excavators, loading machinery such as wheel loaders, grading and roadbed machinery such as bulldozers and motor graders, haulage machinery such as dump trucks, forestry machinery, underground construction machinery such as shield machines, underground mining machinery, environmental recycling machinery, industrial vehicles such as forklifts, diesel engines, hydraulic equipment and castings, and also provides services for them. It also includes solution businesses such as the unmanned dump truck haulage system (AHS), the machine operation management system KOMTRAX, and the construction site management solution Smart ConstructionⓇ. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥3,806,040 million (up 0.2% year on year), segment profit was ¥491,118 million (down 18.0% year on year), and the number of employees was 61,960; both revenue and profit were the largest among the three divisions. As of the end of the period, the ICT construction machinery ratio in Japan, the United States, Europe and Australia was 28.7%, the cumulative number of AHS units introduced was 1,016, and the number of KOMTRAX-connected vehicles was 827,286.
entries.154a0809a3b6bff4: This is the division that handles forging machinery such as servo presses and mechanical presses, sheet metal machinery such as laser processing machines and press brakes, machine tools such as transfer machines and machining centers, defense-related products such as ammunition and armored vehicles, temperature control equipment such as thermo modules, and optical machinery such as excimer lasers for semiconductor exposure equipment. Komatsu Sanki, Komatsu NTC and Gigaphoton are responsible for this division. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥238,750 million (up 6.8% year on year), segment profit was ¥37,937 million (up 38.5%), and the number of employees was 4,276. The company cites higher sales of large presses for the automotive industry and increased maintenance sales in the excimer laser business for the semiconductor industry as the reasons for the increase.

entries.1f8a5e16d760e78d: The KOMATSU LTD. group operates across three segments, 'Construction Machinery and Vehicles,' 'Retail Finance' and 'Industrial Machinery and Others,' conducting everything from product R&D, production, sales and services to sales financing in Japan and overseas. Its distinctive feature is that the business extends beyond selling machines: it provides the financing for purchasing those machines itself and supports their operation after sale through KOMTRAX and AHS as a single business. The group consists of KOMATSU LTD., 211 consolidated subsidiaries and 39 equity-method affiliates. The company defines its raison d'être as 'creating new value through manufacturing and technological innovation and opening up a future in which people, society and the planet thrive together,' and its 'basic management principle' is to pursue 'quality and reliability' in order to maximize the total trust of all stakeholders. Starting in April 2025, it launched its three-year medium-term management plan, 'Driving value with ambition: Challenging for value creation,' and redefined its desired image as 'a solutions partner that realizes safe, productive and clean worksites.' The consolidated financial statements are prepared in accordance with U.S. GAAP, and in the trend of key management indicators, 'income before income taxes' is shown in place of 'ordinary income.'

entries.41995a23e9f79171: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥567,323 million (down 13.7% year on year), and the operating margin was 13.7%, 2.3 points below the previous year. Profit before income taxes was ¥537,258 million (down 11.2% year on year), and profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥376,391 million (down 14.4%). By segment, segment profit was ¥491,118 million for construction machinery and vehicles (down 18.0%), ¥37,937 million for industrial machinery and others (up 38.5%), and ¥36,588 million for Retail Finance (up 24.4%), with construction machinery and vehicles generating most of the profit. On the decline in profit in construction machinery and vehicles, the company states that although it worked to improve selling prices, the decrease was due to higher costs and lower sales volume, and that cost of sales rose 3.3% year on year, reflecting the effects of US tariffs, among other factors. The company also notes that consolidated segment profit does not follow US GAAP but is presented to provide useful information to users of its financial statements.

entries.593bd56865ff7bdc: In addition to construction, mining and forestry machinery and their parts and services, the company provides KOMTRAX, which remotely manages machines' location and operating information (827,286 units as of the end of March 2026); the AHS autonomous haulage system for mining dump trucks (1,016 units in total operation); and Smart Construction Ⓡ, a construction site management solution. R&D expenses for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥121,177 million (up 9.7% year on year), and capital expenditure was ¥183,024 million. The cumulative number of hybrid hydraulic excavators introduced was 6,116 units as of the end of March 2026. For next-generation mining machinery, the company is developing 'power-agnostic dump trucks' that can run on any power source, including diesel engines, batteries and hydrogen fuel cells.
